The user wants an admin panel and user authentication/customer accounts. This is a static site (index.html, styles.css, app.js). We need to add:

1. Admin panel (CRUD products, launches, collections, orders, etc.)
2. User login/signup (customer accounts) with individual experience (favorites, cart per user)
3. Security-ish.

Since it's a static site, implement client-side auth with localStorage. Note limitations honestly (demo only, not real security). Better: build admin.html + admin.js + auth.js, login.html perhaps, plus account page. Use localStorage-based store with seeded data, session handling, hashed passwords (SHA-256 via crypto.subtle) to be a bit better.

Let me plan the architecture:

- `store.js`: data layer — seed products, collections, users, orders, settings; localStorage persistence; password hashing with SHA-256 + salt; session management; auth (register, login, logout); per-user cart & favorites; admin CRUD APIs.
- `auth.js` or combine into `app.js`: customer site integrates login modal, account drawer/page, favorites/cart per user, admin link visibility.
- `conta.html` + `conta.js`: customer account page — profile, orders, favorites, addresses maybe.
- `admin.html` + `admin.js` + `admin.css`: admin dashboard — login gate (admin role), sidebar nav: Dashboard (stats), Produtos (CRUD table + modal form), Lançamentos/Drops (CRUD), Coleções (CRUD), Pedidos (view/status), Clientes (list), Configurações (store settings, banners), cupons maybe.
- Update index.html to load store.js, add login button in header, account menu, auth modal; update app.js to use store instead of static products array, render products dynamically? Currently products are hardcoded in HTML. To let admin changes reflect on storefront, need dynamic rendering from store. That's a bigger refactor but doable: render product grid from store.js, keep filters/search, favorites per user, cart per user.

Let me check existing files first. I have content from context. Let me read current files to be precise.

Let me design data model:

```js
const DB_KEY = 'rua98_db_v1';
{

    {id, name, subtitle, price, compareAt, category: 'oversized'|'old-school', collectionId, image, sizes:['P','M','G','GG'], stock, tag, featured, active, createdAt, description}
  ],
  collections: [{id, name, slug, description, active}],
  drops: [{id, name, date, status, description, productIds?}],
  users: [{id, name, email, passwordHash, salt, role:'admin'|'customer', createdAt, phone?, address?}],
  orders: [{id, userId, items, total, status, createdAt, customer}],
  settings: {storeName, announcement, freeShipping, whatsapp, instagram, heroTitle...}
}
```

Admin seed: email admin@rua98.com, password `rua98admin` (show in UI note / demo credentials). Customer seed maybe demo@rua98.com / demo123. Safer to hash.

Session: `rua98_session` = {userId, token, expiresAt} in localStorage. Token random. Note: front-end demo, security limited; real app needs backend.

Per-user data: cart/favorites stored on user record (`cart`, `favorites`) so each user has own experience. Guest cart? Keep guest cart separate for non-logged users; on login merge or keep. Simpler: guest cart in localStorage `rua98_guest_cart`, favorites too. On login, use user's cart; merge guest cart into user cart maybe. Keep reasonable.

Storefront behavior:
- Header shows "ENTRAR" button when logged out; when logged in, shows account button with name initial / menu (Minha conta, Favoritos, Sair) and admin link if role admin.
- Product rendering dynamic from DB (active products). Keep filters by category, collection maybe add collection filter? Existing filters: TUDO, OVERSIZED, OLD SCHOOL. Admin can add products with category amongst those, or collections. Add collection select? Maybe update filter chips dynamically from categories + collections. Keep categories fixed for simplicity: oversized and old-school, plus "Lançamentos" derived from `isNew` flag. Could add data-driven filters including collections: TUDO, OVERSIZED, OLD SCHOOL + collection chips? Need design consistency.

Let me make filters dynamic: categories from product categories (uniqueness) plus each active collection as filter chip with slug. Could clutter. Better: filter by type (categories) and a collection select? Existing layout has chips; admin "coleções" can be used as product grouping, used on product subtitle or a section on store? Hmm.

Requirement: "atualizar produtos, lançamentos, coleções e tudo que um ADM tem direito em um painel". So admin panel needs sections; storefront should reflect product changes. Collections and drops can be managed in admin, displayed in storefront maybe as filter chips or badges. I'll add:
- Collections: name, slug, description; products have collectionId; storefront filter chips include collection chips? Could use a select in collection toolbar: "COLEÇÃO: TODAS". Or add chips for collections beneath type filters. Simpler: filter chips render "TUDO / OVERSIZED / OLD SCHOOL" plus dynamic collection chips prefixed maybe. On mobile chips wrap fine.
- Drops (lançamentos): name, launch date, status (agendado/ativo/encerrado), product IDs. Storefront: hero eyebrow uses active drop name maybe; product tag "NOVO" if product.isNew; add an "Últimos lançamentos" strip? Could avoid overcomplicating. Admin manages drops, and storefront hero announcement reflects active drop name/description. Also admin dashboard counts.

Admin panel UI: same visual language (paper, ink, red, green, Space Grotesk/DM Mono). Separate admin.html with login screen when not admin; auth check redirect to index if not admin? - Dashboard: KPIs (produtos ativos, pedidos, receita, clientes), recent orders, low stock alert, chart (CSS bars of sales last 7 days? orders seeded). Maybe simple.
- Produtos: table with image, name, price, stock, status; search; add/edit modal with fields name, subtitle, description, price, compare price, category, collection, image URL, sizes, stock, tag, isNew, active; delete confirm.

- Configurações: store settings (announcement text, free shipping threshold, Instagram, WhatsApp, hero title, checkout note), save; data reset (restore demo), export JSON.

Also admin should be able to create additional admin users? "tudo que um ADM tem direito" maybe settings include team. Add in settings: "Equipe" to add admin accounts. Could include in Clientes section: change role? Simple: in settings have "Adicionar administrador" form. Hmm scope.

Customer account page (`conta.html`):
- Require login, else redirect/login form inline.
- Tabs: Visão geral, Meus pedidos, Favoritos, Dados.
- Shows orders (seed none until checkout). Checkout should create order for logged user; require login at checkout. Update cart drawer checkout: if not logged, open auth modal ("Entre para finalizar"). If logged, create order, clear cart, show success toast and order appears in account + admin orders. That fulfills per-user experience.

- Tabs Entrar / Criar conta. Fields name (register), email, password, confirm? Just password min 6. Show errors. Password hashing async. Session persistent 30 days (localStorage).
- Forgot password? Demo: no email; maybe omit. Note in UI.

Also admin login on admin.html should share the login form but only admin allowed.

Per-user favorites: current favorite buttons stateless. Change: if not logged, prompt login modal when favoriting (or allow guest favorites). Per-user experience suggests require login; but forcing may annoy. We'll store guest favorites and migrate on login. Simpler: favorites require login → open auth modal with message; guest gets prompt. Keep.

Cart: allow guest cart but checkout requires login. On login, merge guest cart to user cart. Good.

Need to update product cards rendering to include collection, stock, sizes, etc. Rewrite app.js significantly.

Also images: admin can change image URL. Fine.

Files:
- store.js (shared)
- auth-modal markup included in index.html and conta.html? Could inject via JS to avoid duplication. Let's create `ui.js`? Simpler: create markup in both pages (and admin uses its own login). Could build auth modal dynamically in store.js function `mountAuthModal()`? Better separate `auth-ui.js` that injects modal + header account menu, used by index and conta.
